question: HippoRAG 的 HotpotQA 与 ToG-2 的 AdvHotpotQA 是什么关系？引用两篇的设置说明，判断能否直接用结果数字比较两种检索方法。
answer: HippoRAG 的实验结论是在 HotpotQA（原文写作 HotpotQA）上报告 QA 结果，并将其与 ColBERTv2、IRCoT 等检索基线比较，使用的是同一 QA reader 条件[chunk_d374bd95d509d622be8512f20e59b674]。ToG-2 则是在 AdvHotpotQA 上报告结果，表 1 以 GPT-3.5-turbo 为统一底座比较不同方法，AdvHotpotQA 指标为 EM[chunk_2e13f6f43858420cb85904c33d3b39df]；另有表按 Llama-3-8B、Qwen2-7B、GPT-3.5-turbo、GPT-4o 分别列出 ToG-2 在 AdvHotpotQA 上的得分[chunk_9c3795187f69ce14c244c9ad74c8e821]。两条证据只表明二者分别涉及 HotpotQA 与 AdvHotpotQA，并未说明 AdvHotpotQA 与 HotpotQA 的构造关系、数据划分或评测协议是否一致；因此仅凭所给原文，无法判断可直接用两者结果数字比较两种检索方法，流程与可比性证据不足。

The main results of several open-source datasets are shown in Table 1. We note that ToG-2 out-
performs other baselines on WebQSP, AdvHotpotQA, QALD-10-en, and Zero-Shot RE. Notably,
WebQSP, AdvHotpotQA and QALD-10-en are multi-hop reasoning datasets. On Fever, ToG-2 has
a competitive performance to CoK since the fact statements in Fever mainly are about single-hop
relations and thus do not need in-depth information retrieval. In another fact verification dataset
Creak, all fact statements can be verified based on Wikidata. Thus, ToG-2 and ToG have similar per-
formances on Creak. Meanwhile, compared to original ToG, ToG-2 achieved a substantial improve-
ment on AdvHotpotQA (16.6%) and also demonstrated notable enhancements on other datasets
(4.93% on WebQSP, 3.85% on QALD-10-en, 3% on Zero-Shot RE, and 10.4% on FEVER). This
demonstrates the advantages of our KG×Text RAG framework in addressing complex problems.

ColBERTv2 and IRCoT, as well as IRCoT using HippoRAG as a retriever in Table 4. As expected,
improved retrieval performance in both single and multi-step settings leads to strong overall im-
provements of up to 3%, 17% and 1% F1 scores on MuSiQue, 2WikiMultiHopQA and HotpotQA
respectively using the same QA reader. Notably, single-step HippoRAG is on par or outperforms
IRCoT while being 10-30 times cheaper and 6-13 times faster during online retrieval (Appendix G).
